milestones.title: Prove offline speech early
milestones.entryCondition: M1-1 must be done; settings implementation need not be finished.
milestones.forecastNote: Critical technical gate. One focused diagnosis session if the experiment fails.
milestones.outcome: A verified speech approach on the target device, or an explicit blocker and mentor decision.
milestones.demo: With network disabled, recognize the chosen phrase after silence and unrelated speech, stop, and repeat.
concepts: Offline recognition means audio is processed on the device.
A speech session can finish before Safety Mode is stopped.
Device APIs can be unavailable even when the project builds.
milestones.teachBack: Why is recognizing a phrase once different from keeping Safety Mode usable after a pause?
acceptance: Device/API, speech package version, language availability, and repeatable results recorded.
No audio storage or online fallback in the chosen implementation; offline device behavior checked.
Silence, unrelated speech, repeat recognition, Stop, and microphone denial tested.
Foreground/lock-screen behavior agreed; unresolved failure blocks voice integration rather than being labelled success.

tasks.title: Implement a minimal offline speech experiment and inspect privacy/configuration; keep it small and reusable
evidence: 2026-09-24 agent added a separate Android offline-speech experiment page using Android SpeechRecognizer.CreateOnDeviceSpeechRecognizer, which explicitly creates an on-device recognizer with no online fallback. The page queries Android 13+ support for the en-US offline model, requests microphone permission only when Listen is tapped, runs a single en-US recognition session, shows partial/final text and errors, offers cancellation, and destroys the recognizer when leaving. Android manifest declares RECORD_AUDIO and the recognition-service query. Android compile target passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. Device/language/offline behavior is not yet verified.

tasks.title: Run the speech matrix on the physical phone, report outcomes, and explain offline versus online processing
evidence: 2026-09-24 student first reported `LanguageUnavailable` for en-US using the explicit on-device recognizer; Android defines this as a supported language currently unavailable, such as a model not yet downloaded. HyperOS Settings search did not expose an on-device model menu, so agent added an in-app Android 13+ support check and model-download request. Student now reports that English speech recognition works in the updated app. Whether it works with all network connectivity disabled, repeated sessions, silence/unrelated speech, and Stop remains unverified.
